title: Chapter 172 I Will Marry You
content:
Chapter 172 I Will Marry You

Not very convenient?

Everyone looked puzzled. Could it be that the Lord of the Huangcheng City was injured in order to deal with the Spirit-Devouring Clan, so he was in seclusion and recuperating.

Thinking of this, the people of the Divine Dynasty became more and more respectful to the Lord of the Huangcheng City.

However, this is only what a few people think.

Awei and Gu Chen knew it well.

Lord, I guess I am working hard at this moment.

But naturally a few people dared not say it.

"Miss, then I will go back first."

Awei stepped forward and bowed to Lu Xue.

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue nodded, "Okay, I will notify you when my father summons you."

Then, Huang Shouyunqi and others also took their leave one after another.

After the few people left, Lu Xue came to Jian Xin and others.

At this moment, only Gu Chen is left here yet.

"Master."

At this time, Lu Xue looked at Gu Chen with a smile in her eyes.

"Xiaoxue, I just happened to have something to tell you about as a teacher."

When Lu Xue heard that his master was about to tell him something, he was a little confused.

At this time, Gu Chen had already pulled her to the side.

Immediately, Gu Chen sent a voice to Lu Xue in a low voice.

"Xiaoxue, what do you think, Jian Xin Muyu and the others?"

"Uh, it's very good."

"Then do you think the Divine Dynasty and Huangcheng are family?"

"yes."

"Then do you want them to stay here and strengthen the Wilderness City?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue reacted no matter how stupid she was.

"Master, do you want to?"

Gu Chen smiled and nodded slightly.

Seeing this, Lu Xue was silent for a moment, then nodded.

"good."

Anyway, they are also their mothers. If some of their mothers are asked to do things for their fathers, they probably won’t mind their mothers.

Immediately, the two reached a consensus.

At this moment, Jian Xin and others did not realize that they and others had been targeted.

"Mu Yu."

Jian Xin walked to Mu Yu and spoke softly.

"Huh? What, what's wrong?"

Looking at Mu Yu who was a little out of condition, Jian Xin sighed in his heart and then said, "Mu Yu, what do you think of Gu Chen?"

Hearing this question, Mu Yu's face turned slightly red and he quickly lowered his head.

"Yes, very good."

Seeing Mu Yu's reaction, Jian Xin's face remained unmoved and continued to ask, "Do you like him?"

Suddenly, Mu Yu's face turned redder and he held the staff and waved his hands repeatedly.

"I, I didn't, I just, saved my life by him, so,"

"So decided to agree with your body?"

"I,,"

Mu Yu lowered his head tightly and couldn't spit out a word.

Seeing this, Jian Xin rolled his eyes.

She understood clearly, Mu Yu would probably give it to him for nothing.

At this time, Lu Xue and Gu Chen also walked slowly over from a distance.

"Well, Miss Mu Yu, what's wrong with you? Why are your face so red?"

Seeing Mu Yu’s strange appearance, Gu Chen said in confusion.

On the side, Lu Xue was also a little confused.

It was fine just now.

"Ah, I,,,"

Hearing Gu Chen's words, Mu Yu's heart beat faster. Is this the feeling of a deer ramming around?

No, what are you thinking! !

However, before Mu Yu finished speaking, Gu Chen suddenly said loudly.

"Ao~ I understand, Miss Mu Yu, you are shocked by the magnificence of my Huangcheng. Hahaha, it's okay. People who come to my Huangcheng for the first time usually have this kind of reaction."

Hearing this, Mu Yu twitched slightly and said, "Yes, yes."

At this time, Jian Xin could no longer bear to see, so he bowed to Lu Xue and said, "Your Highness, please take us around the deserted city."

Hearing this, Lu Xue was stunned for a moment, and nodded quickly and said, "Okay."

"only,,"

Lu Xue glanced at Gu Chen and Mu Yu next to her.

Seeing this, Jian Xin took a deep breath and then said to Gu Chen: "Brother Gu Chen, please take Mu Yu to stroll around the deserted city."

Hearing this, Gu Chen was a little stunned.

Why can't I go shopping together?

However, before he could ask questions, Lu Xue had already left here with Jian Xin and other gods.

The speed is very fast, and the back can no longer be seen.

"Jian Xin, the two of them?"

Lu Xue's eyes were filled with stars and she looked at Jian Xin and asked.

"Well, Your Highness, I'm sorry, I'm embarrassed."

Jian Xin looked a little uncomfortable.

Hearing this, Lu Xue waved her hand quickly, "No, they two, haha, they are quite compatible."

Lu Xue suddenly understood, and for some reason, she was a little excited.

On the other side.

"Uh, Miss Mu Yu, let's go for a walk?"

In place, Gu Chen hesitated.

After hearing Gu Chen's words, Mu Yu did not refuse.

He nodded slightly, as if he agreed.

Then, the two of them turned around aimlessly from the deserted city.

The deserted city is very big and almost became a small world alone.

The two of them moved for a long time and were still in the outer city area.

Along the way, Mu Yu gradually returned to normal and began to look at everything in the deserted city.

She discovered that there were many things in the deserted city that she had never seen before.

For example, the thing in front of me that emits cold air and looks a bit tempting.

Seeing Mu Yu being curious, Gu Chen also sent a lot of money to buy one for Mu Yu.

"No, I'll give it to you. This is called ice cream. It's delicious and also helps in cultivation."

"However, the higher the realm, the lower the effect. For us, just taste it."

Mu Yu took the ice cream that Gu Chen mentioned without hesitation and took a bite.

"Well, delicious!"

The ice cream melted in her mouth and had a milky aroma, which suited her taste.

"How is it? My deserted city is good, right?"

Gu Chen smiled at this time.

Mu Yu nodded and said, "Very good."

"Then do you want to stay?"

Hearing this, Mu Yu was stunned.

Stay?

Is it possible?

This, this is a bit too sudden.

In a flash, Mu Yu's little face turned red again.

It's hard to imagine that this is a great wizard of the god general level with many means.

On the contrary, it's more like a little girl who is just beginning to fall in love.

"But, but I'm not ready yet."

Mu Yu said weakly.

However, Gu Chen's smile became even more intense.

This is not a refusal, which means there is a lot of drama.

Then, Gu Chen stepped up and said, "What are you afraid of? Everyone in my Desolate City is talented and speaks well. Once you get used to it, you will definitely like it here."

"And even your majesty is the wife of the city lord of my Desolate City. As a subordinate of the city lord's wife, no one will say anything if you stay in Desolate City."

Gu Chen's words made sense, but Mu Yu was still a little hesitant.

"Isn't this too fast?"

We have just known each other for such a short time,

Mu Yu held the staff in his hand, lowered his head tightly, and spoke very softly. Gu Chen leaned very close to hear clearly.

"Fast? What's fast? You have to consider your future?"

In Desolate City, the future is definitely bright.

It must be much better than in the Divine Dynasty.

However, the Divine Dynasty Queen is the wife of the City Lord, so it is hard to say what the Divine Dynasty will be like in the future.

However, Mu Yu naturally misunderstood Gu Chen's meaning.

After a long time, Mu Yu mustered up the courage and looked up and looked directly into Gu Chen's eyes.

"Can you guarantee my future?"

The two were very close, and because Gu Chen was tall, Mu Yu's head barely reached Gu Chen's shoulders.

When Gu Chen heard Mu Yu's words, he was overjoyed.

This is going to work.

Haha, got one!

"Miss Mu Yu, don't worry, I guarantee your future in the deserted city with my personality."

Gu Chen patted his chest and vowed.

Looking at Gu Chen, Mu Yu took a deep breath and finally made up her mind.

"Okay, I'll marry you."

......

The smile on Gu Chen's face froze instantly.

"Ah?"
